title: 第9章 击杀阴阳学宫长老布置阵法第10章 青铜古镜的逆天推演能力
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
紫袍中年人强撑着身体，缓缓站起身。
尽管口中还有鲜血渗出，但是他依然保持着高傲。
“你是何人，竟敢与我阴阳学宫作对？”
楚云缓缓收回手臂，道：“你不是要杀我吗？现在我就站在你面前，你居然不知道我是谁。”
紫袍中年人目光一凝，道：“你就是楚云，你怎么可能有地武境修为？”
楚云的年龄，他感觉也就十四五岁。
这样的年纪，怎么可能达到地武境。
要知道，就算号称青州第一天才的段惊天，修炼到二十岁，也只有地武境修为。
楚云没有回答他，而是开口道：“我现在给你两个选择，一个在我面前自刎，我留你一个全尸，还有一个就是我动手，让你变成一具干尸。”
紫袍中年人愤怒道：“狂妄，刚才要不是你出手偷袭，你以为能伤我？”
楚云的修为，他已经看出只有地武境七重，而他有地武境八重。
他不信自己比楚云高一重修为，还杀不了对方。
楚云道：“既然你不信，那我们就试试。”
说话间，楚云朝着他走去。
见到楚云走来，紫袍中年人露出凝重之色，开始调动大地之力。
他很清楚，如果这一击不能杀死楚云，那么死的一定是他。
刷！
就在这时，楚云率先发动攻击。
只见他一掌朝着紫袍中年人轰去。
紫袍中年人见状，同样轰出一掌。

砰！
随着两人的手掌碰撞在一起，周围的楚家族人，都露出紧张之色。
然而下一刻，他们便看见紫袍中年人面目扭曲，露出痛苦之色。
“小子，你在吸我的修为？”
紫袍中年人慌了，他发现自己的修为，正在快速流逝。
楚云没有说话，但是嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
正常情况下，他无法吸收比他修为高的武者修为。
但是紫袍中年人，刚才已经被他打伤，战力大打折扣。
所以他现在出其不意，完全可以吸走对方的修为。
“你……你是天魔教的人。”
感受着快速流逝的修为，紫袍中年人勃然大怒。
然而楚云没有理会他，开始加大力度运转《吞天诀》。
见楚云不说话，紫袍中年人更加肯定心中的猜测。
“你楚家竟然敢跟天魔教勾结，就算我今日杀不了你，你楚家也会被其他武道正派攻击。”
见楚云不为所动，紫袍中年人慌了。
“你要是肯放过我，我或许可以帮你保密。”
然而楚云依旧不为所动。
啊！
随着一声惨叫发出，紫袍中年人被吸成了一具干尸。
楚云立即盘膝坐下，开始炼化对方的修为。

“少爷修炼的到底是什么功法，居然能够吸走对方的修为。”
content_en:
The middle-aged man in purple robe supported his body and stood up slowly.
Although there was blood oozing from his mouth, he still remained proud.
"Who are you to dare to go against my Yin Yang Academy?"
Chu Yun slowly retracted his arm and said, "Aren't you going to kill me? Now I'm standing in front of you, and you don't know who I am."
The middle-aged man in purple robes focused his eyes and said: "You are Chu Yun, how can you have the cultivation level of Earth Martial Realm?"
Chu Yun's age, he felt, was only fourteen or fifteen years old.
How could it be possible to reach the Earth Martial Realm at such an age.
You know, even if Duan Jingtian, who is known as the number one genius in Qingzhou, has cultivated to the age of twenty, he is only at the Earth Martial Realm.
Chu Yun did not answer him, but said: "I will give you two choices now. One is to kill yourself in front of me, and I will leave you with a whole corpse. The other is that I will do it and turn you into a mummy."
The middle-aged man in purple robe said angrily: "Arrogant, if you hadn't made a sneak attack just now, do you think you could hurt me?"
He had already seen that Chu Yun's cultivation was only at the seventh level of the Earth Martial Realm, while he was at the eighth level of the Earth Martial Realm.
He didn't believe that he was one level higher than Chu Yun in cultivation and still couldn't kill him.
Chu Yun said: "Since you don't believe it, let's try it."
While talking, Chu Yun walked towards him.
Seeing Chu Yun approaching, the middle-aged man in purple robe showed a solemn expression and began to mobilize the power of the earth.
He knew very well that if this blow could not kill Chu Yun, then it would be him who died.
brush!
At this moment, Chu Yun took the lead in launching an attack.
I saw him hitting the middle-aged man in purple robe with his palm.
Seeing this, the middle-aged man in purple robe also struck out with a palm.
Bang!
As the palms of the two people collided, the Chu family members around them all showed nervous expressions.
However, the next moment, they saw the face of the middle-aged man in purple robe twisted, showing a look of pain.
"Boy, are you sucking my cultivation?"
The middle-aged man in purple robe panicked. He found that his cultivation level was rapidly passing away.
Chu Yun said nothing, but a sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Under normal circumstances, he cannot absorb the cultivation level of a warrior higher than his own.
But the middle-aged man in purple robe had been injured by him just now, and his combat power was greatly reduced.
So now he was caught off guard and could completely absorb the opponent's cultivation.
"You...you are from the Demon Sect."
Feeling the rapid passage of cultivation, the middle-aged man in purple robe became furious.
However, Chu Yun ignored him and began to increase his efforts in operating the "Swallowing Heaven Technique".
Seeing that Chu Yun didn't speak, the middle-aged man in purple robe became more sure of his guess.
"Your Chu family actually dares to collude with the Demon Sect. Even if I can't kill you today, your Chu family will be attacked by other decent martial arts sects."
Seeing that Chu Yun was unmoved, the middle-aged man in purple robe panicked.
"If you are willing to let me go, I might be able to keep it a secret for you."
However, Chu Yun remained unmoved.
ah!
With a scream, the middle-aged man in purple robe was sucked into a mummy.
Chu Yun immediately sat down cross-legged and began to refine the opponent's cultivation.
"What kind of technique does the young master practice that can actually absorb the opponent's cultivation level?"
